meta.description: Turn livestreams and long videos into professional clips, edit them and publish them.

app.verifyEmail: Confirm your email with the link we sent you. Until then some actions may be limited.

auth.sessionsNote: Changing your password signs you out of your other sessions.

shell.tagline: From a long stream to clips ready to publish.
shell.body: Upload a video or connect your livestream, let AI find the best moments, fine-tune them in the studio and publish to your channels.
shell.legal: Klick is by Visionary AI Group.

login.title: Sign in to Klick
login.subtitle: Use your email and password, or continue with Google.
login.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
login.oidcFailed: We couldn't complete sign-in with Google. Try again.
login.resetDone: Password updated. Sign in with the new one.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: It takes a minute. Then you create your organization.
register.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. Don't use your email.
register.passwordShort: The password must be at least {min} characters long.
register.doneBody: If {email} can be registered, we sent a link to confirm the account. It may take a few minutes.

forgot.title: Recover your password
forgot.subtitle: We'll email you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.doneBody: If an account exists for that email, we sent a link to reset the password. It expires soon.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Use a password you haven't used anywhere else.
reset.missingBody: Open the full link we emailed you, or request a new one.

verify.title: Confirm email
verify.missingBody: Open the full link we emailed you.

invite.title: Organization invitation
invite.needLogin: Sign in or create an account with the invited email to accept.
invite.subtitle: You're about to join with the account {email}.
invite.emailNote: The invitation only works with the email it was sent to.
invite.missingBody: Open the full link we emailed you.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.recoverySubtitle: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each one works only once.
mfa.recoveryHint: You saved it when you turned on two-step verification.

panel.title: Dashboard
panel.noOrgTitle: You don't have an organization yet
panel.noOrgBody: An organization groups your team, videos and channels. Create one to get started.

system.title: System check
system.body: Start a background job and watch its progress live. Use it to confirm everything is connected.
system.noPermission: Only people who manage the organization can run it.
system.failedMessage: The job failed. You can run it again.

access.title: Your access
access.body: In this organization you have the {role} role.

create.title: Create an organization
create.subtitle: You'll be its owner. You can invite your team afterwards.
create.name: Name
create.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Leave it empty and we'll generate it.

members.title: Members and invitations
members.subtitle: Who has access to {org} and with which role.
members.readOnly: You can see who is part of the organization, but only people who manage members can change it.
members.removeBody: They will lose access to the organization immediately. You can invite them again later.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.onBody: When you sign in we'll ask for a code from your authenticator app.
mfa.offBody: Add an extra layer: besides your password, you'll use a code from your authenticator app.
mfa.copyFailed: We couldn't copy. Select them and copy by hand.
mfa.codesBody: They help if you lose your app. Each code works once and we won't show them again.
mfa.disableBody: Enter a current code from your app to confirm it's you.
mfa.passwordHint: Only if your account has a password.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.scan: Scan the code with your authenticator app and type the code it shows.
mfa.manualKey: Or enter this key by hand

sessions.title: Open sessions
sessions.body: Devices where your account is signed in. Sign out of the ones you don't recognize.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.body: To connect tools and MCP clients to {org} with limited permissions.
tokens.emptyBody: Create one when another tool needs to act on your behalf.
tokens.newBody: Choose only the permissions the tool needs.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.createdBody: This is the only time you'll see it. Keep it somewhere safe.
tokens.copyFailed: We couldn't copy. Select it and copy by hand.
tokens.revokeBody: Tools that use it will stop working immediately.

errors.network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.server: The server had a problem. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment before trying again.
errors.weak_password: The password is too weak. Don't use your email or obvious data.
errors.invalid_mfa_code: The code is wrong or has expired.
errors.mfa_challenge_expired: Too much time passed. Sign in again.
errors.invalid_token: The link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.session_expired: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.invalid_refresh_token: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.refresh_reuse_detected: We signed you out for security. Sign in again.
errors.validation_error: Check the data and try again.
errors.not_found: We couldn't find what you're looking for.
errors.conflict: That action conflicts with the current state. Refresh and try again.
errors.slug_taken: That identifier is already in use. Choose another.
errors.already_member: That person is already part of the organization.
errors.last_owner: The organization must have at least one owner.
errors.unknown_scope: One of the permissions doesn't exist or you can't grant it.
errors.oidc_failed: We couldn't complete sign-in with Google.
errors.internal_error: The server had a problem. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.rights_not_confirmed: Confirm that you have the right to use this content.
errors.upload_too_large: The file exceeds the maximum allowed size (20 GB).
errors.unsupported_media_type: That format is not allowed. Upload a common video, audio or image file.
errors.too_many_uploads: Too many uploads are in progress. Wait for one to finish.
errors.upload_size_mismatch: The file arrived incomplete. Upload it again.
errors.upload_incomplete: Some parts of the file are missing. Retry the upload.
errors.upload_expired: The upload expired. Start a new one.
errors.upload_not_open: This upload is no longer available. Start a new one.
errors.invalid_filename: The file name is not valid.
errors.part_failed: A part of the file could not be sent. Retry.

pages.notFoundBody: The address doesn't exist or is no longer available.
pages.errorBody: We had a problem showing this screen. You can try again or go back home.

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Your videos, audio and images. Upload a file to get started.

upload.title: Upload files
upload.hint: Drag files here or choose them from your computer. They are sent in parts: you can pause and resume.
upload.dropping: Drop the files to upload them
upload.rights: I confirm that I have the right to use this content.
upload.rightsHelp: Only upload your own or authorized material. We record this confirmation with your user and the date.
upload.needRights: Tick the rights confirmation to be able to upload files.
upload.readOnly: Your role can view the library but not upload files.

list.title: Files
list.emptyBody: Upload your first video to see it here.
list.name: Name
